headline: Wanbury Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Wanbury Limited has disclosed a substantial acquisition or change in shareholding under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), triggering public disclosure requirements for the transaction on NSE.
detail: Wanbury Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which mandates public notification when a person acquires shares or voting rights breaching 5% or 25% thresholds, or when control changes hands. The disclosure document was filed with the exchange on or around 19 June 2026. Without access to the full disclosure PDF, the specific acquirer, share count, consideration amount, and deal structure remain to be corroborated from official sources.
